## Content Deletion Request

> ℹ️ Contributors cannot delete content directly. All deletions of posts or author folders must be reviewed and carried out by the repository owner. Please fill in this form to request such an action.

**What do you want deleted?**
- [ ] A single post (`.md` file)
- [ ] An entire author folder

**Path to the content:**
<!-- e.g. content/your-username/03-03-2026-my-post.md  or  content/your-username/ -->

**Reason for the deletion request:**
<!-- e.g. I want to remove this post, the content was posted by mistake, I am leaving the blog, etc. -->

**Are you the author of this content?**
- [ ] Yes, I am the author
- [ ] No — please explain your relationship to this content below

---
*The repository owner will review this request and act on it. Do not attempt to push deletions directly if you do not have sufficient permissions.*
